enemies . . . dark disguise] The oppressors, domestic and foreign, who conceal their true nature
beneath the robes of established power.
 earthly things] In the draft S. originally wrote, then canc. ‘adored worms’ (Nbk 14 p. 20): his first
thought makes the sense of ll. 25–7 clearer; they apply to those who appropriate the name of Liberty
without right.
 wear] bear 1840.
 as Kings [ ]] as kings are 1840. As in l. 12, S. has left a gap in the draft to be filled in later. Cp. What
men gain fairly, that should they possess ll. 8–10 and note.
